_comment: The homepage's study tracks — the ONE list behind the #tracks cards, the hero chips, the announcement bar and the closing line, in both index.html and en/index.html. Edit here, then run `node scripts/render-tracks.mjs` and commit the pages with it; `--check` fails if a page drifted. In blurbs, {{…}} marks a Latin run inside Hebrew (rendered as <span class="ltr-iso">). `cta` adds data-cta (counted in cta_click); `pageLang` marks a destination page in another language (on /en it shows a "Hebrew content" pill).
